description: Part 9 lesson 09-06 (data queues, P15/P34). Order of work: (1) pre-wrapper sh probes PRB0-PRB13 on a throw-away queue Z0906P and message queue Z0906Q: SEND_DATA_QUEUE named vs positional vs default library, RECEIVE_DATA_QUEUE named vs positional vs REMOVE => NO vs timeout on an empty queue, DATA_QUEUE_ENTRIES / DATA_QUEUE_INFO, MESSAGE_QUEUE_INFO view vs table function (db2 prints the real SQLSTATE, so errors are informative). (2) One CL wrapper job: CHGCURLIB, library-list record, DLTDTAQ->CRTDTAQ reset of Z0906A (request) and Z0906B (reply), CRTMSGQ Z0906C, compile worker C0906A (CRTCLPGM), queue 9 requests through SQL (named, positional, *LIBL forms; ECHO, EXIST, STOCK x2, EXIST NOSUCH, BOGUS, END x2), SBMJOB the worker (CURLIB and INLLIBL explicit, INQMSGRPY(*DFT), LOG(4 00 *SECLVL), worker lives 2 minutes at most), read the replies with RECEIVE_DATA_QUEUE WAIT_TIME 60/10 into VFYRC1-8 (CTAS keeps the real column types visible), wait 5 s, ACTIVE_JOB_INFO for the worker, DATA_QUEUE_ENTRIES leftovers, worker notices from the own message queue, copy the worker log table W0906A into VFYWLOG, then delete queues, msgq, worker program and W0906A. (3) collect only reads the persistent VFY tables plus catalog views. Safety: nothing outside &LIB is created or changed; no ADDJOBSCDE; the worker cannot loop forever (MAXMSG 10, MAXIDLE 6 x 20 s).

steps.label: PRB0
steps.cmd: system "DLTDTAQ DTAQ(&LIB/Z0906P)" 2>&1; system "CRTDTAQ DTAQ(&LIB/Z0906P) MAXLEN(128) SEQ(*FIFO) TEXT('09-06 probe queue')" 2>&1; system "DLTMSGQ MSGQ(&LIB/Z0906Q)" 2>&1; system "CRTMSGQ MSGQ(&LIB/Z0906Q) TEXT('09-06 probe msgq')" 2>&1; system "SNDMSG MSG('probe message') TOMSGQ(&LIB/Z0906Q)" 2>&1

steps.label: PRB1NAMED
steps.cmd: db2 "CALL QSYS2.SEND_DATA_QUEUE(MESSAGE_DATA => 'PROBE-NAMED', DATA_QUEUE => 'Z0906P', DATA_QUEUE_LIBRARY => '&LIB')" 2>&1

steps.label: PRB2POS
steps.cmd: db2 "CALL QSYS2.SEND_DATA_QUEUE('PROBE-POS', 'Z0906P', '&LIB')" 2>&1

steps.label: PRB3DEFLIB

steps.label: PRB4RCVN
steps.cmd: db2 "SELECT * FROM TABLE(QSYS2.RECEIVE_DATA_QUEUE(DATA_QUEUE => 'Z0906P', DATA_QUEUE_LIBRARY => '&LIB', WAIT_TIME => 5)) X" 2>&1

steps.label: PRB5RCVP
steps.cmd: db2 "SELECT * FROM TABLE(QSYS2.RECEIVE_DATA_QUEUE('Z0906P', '&LIB', 5)) X" 2>&1

steps.label: PRB6ENTS
steps.cmd: db2 "SELECT * FROM TABLE(QSYS2.DATA_QUEUE_ENTRIES(DATA_QUEUE => 'Z0906P', DATA_QUEUE_LIBRARY => '&LIB')) X" 2>&1

steps.label: PRB7INFO
steps.cmd: db2 "SELECT * FROM QSYS2.DATA_QUEUE_INFO WHERE DATA_QUEUE_LIBRARY = '&LIB' AND DATA_QUEUE_NAME = 'Z0906P'" 2>&1

steps.label: PRB8PEEK
steps.cmd: db2 "SELECT * FROM TABLE(QSYS2.RECEIVE_DATA_QUEUE(DATA_QUEUE => 'Z0906P', DATA_QUEUE_LIBRARY => '&LIB', WAIT_TIME => 2, REMOVE => 'NO')) X" 2>&1

steps.label: PRB9DRAIN
steps.cmd: db2 "SELECT * FROM TABLE(QSYS2.RECEIVE_DATA_QUEUE(DATA_QUEUE => 'Z0906P', DATA_QUEUE_LIBRARY => '&LIB', WAIT_TIME => 2)) X" 2>&1

steps.label: PRB10EMPTY
steps.cmd: db2 "SELECT * FROM TABLE(QSYS2.RECEIVE_DATA_QUEUE(DATA_QUEUE => 'Z0906P', DATA_QUEUE_LIBRARY => '&LIB', WAIT_TIME => 2)) X" 2>&1

steps.cmd: db2 "SELECT * FROM QSYS2.MESSAGE_QUEUE_INFO WHERE MESSAGE_QUEUE_LIBRARY = '&LIB' AND MESSAGE_QUEUE_NAME = 'Z0906Q'" 2>&1

steps.label: PRB12MQF

steps.label: PRB13DEL
steps.cmd: system "DLTDTAQ DTAQ(&LIB/Z0906P)" 2>&1; system "DLTMSGQ MSGQ(&LIB/Z0906Q)" 2>&1

steps.label: CURSET
steps.cmd: CHGCURLIB CURLIB(&LIB)

steps.label: MKCUR
steps.cmd: RUNSQL SQL('CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE &LIB/VFYCUR (TAG VARCHAR(40), ORD INT, LIB VARCHAR(20), TYPE VARCHAR(10))') COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: REC0

steps.label: PRECLEAN
steps.cmd:
DLTDTAQ DTAQ(&LIB/Z0906A)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
DLTDTAQ DTAQ(&LIB/Z0906B)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
DLTMSGQ MSGQ(&LIB/Z0906C)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
DLTPGM PGM(&LIB/C0906A)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)

steps.label: MKLOG
steps.cmd: RUNSQL SQL('CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE &LIB/W0906A (SEQ INTEGER GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY, TS TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT TIMESTAMP, PHASE VARCHAR(8), MSG VARCHAR(100))') COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: MKWORK
steps.cmd: CRTCLPGM PGM(&LIB/C0906A) SRCFILE(&LIB/QCLSRC) SRCMBR(C0906A) REPLACE(*YES)

steps.label: MKQ
steps.cmd:
CRTDTAQ DTAQ(&LIB/Z0906A) MAXLEN(128) SEQ(*FIFO) TEXT('09-06 request queue')
CRTDTAQ DTAQ(&LIB/Z0906B) MAXLEN(128) SEQ(*FIFO) TEXT('09-06 reply queue')
CRTMSGQ MSGQ(&LIB/Z0906C) TEXT('09-06 worker notices')

steps.label: S1NAMED
steps.cmd: RUNSQL SQL('CALL QSYS2.SEND_DATA_QUEUE(MESSAGE_DATA => ''ECHO HELLO-NAMED'', DATA_QUEUE => ''Z0906A'', DATA_QUEUE_LIBRARY => ''&LIB'')') COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: S4STK2
steps.cmd: RUNSQL SQL('CALL QSYS2.SEND_DATA_QUEUE(MESSAGE_DATA => ''STOCK P00002'', DATA_QUEUE => ''Z0906A'', DATA_QUEUE_LIBRARY => ''&LIB'')') COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: S5STK1

steps.label: S6NOEX

steps.label: S7BOGUS
steps.cmd: RUNSQL SQL('CALL QSYS2.SEND_DATA_QUEUE(MESSAGE_DATA => ''BOGUS X'', DATA_QUEUE => ''Z0906A'', DATA_QUEUE_LIBRARY => ''&LIB'')') COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: S8END
steps.cmd: RUNSQL SQL('CALL QSYS2.SEND_DATA_QUEUE(MESSAGE_DATA => ''END'', DATA_QUEUE => ''Z0906A'', DATA_QUEUE_LIBRARY => ''&LIB'')') COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: S9END2
steps.cmd: RUNSQL SQL('CALL QSYS2.SEND_DATA_QUEUE(''END'', ''Z0906A'', ''&LIB'')') COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: SUBMIT
steps.cmd: SBMJOB CMD(CALL PGM(&LIB/C0906A) PARM('&LIB')) JOB(C0906A) CURLIB(&LIB) INLLIBL(*JOBD) INQMSGRPY(*DFT) LOG(4 00 *SECLVL)

steps.label: R1
steps.cmd: RUNSQL SQL('CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE &LIB/VFYRC1 AS (SELECT * FROM TABLE(QSYS2.RECEIVE_DATA_QUEUE(DATA_QUEUE => ''Z0906B'', DATA_QUEUE_LIBRARY => ''&LIB'', WAIT_TIME => 60)) X) WITH DATA') COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.cmd: RUNSQL SQL('CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE &LIB/VFYRC2 AS (SELECT CAST(MESSAGE_DATA AS VARCHAR(200)) AS MSG FROM TABLE(QSYS2.RECEIVE_DATA_QUEUE(DATA_QUEUE => ''Z0906B'', DATA_QUEUE_LIBRARY => ''&LIB'', WAIT_TIME => 10)) X) WITH DATA') COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.cmd: RUNSQL SQL('CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE &LIB/VFYRC3 AS (SELECT CAST(MESSAGE_DATA AS VARCHAR(200)) AS MSG FROM TABLE(QSYS2.RECEIVE_DATA_QUEUE(DATA_QUEUE => ''Z0906B'', DATA_QUEUE_LIBRARY => ''&LIB'', WAIT_TIME => 10)) X) WITH DATA') COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: SETTLE
steps.cmd: DLYJOB DLY(5)

steps.label: JOB2
steps.cmd: RUNSQL SQL('CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE &LIB/VFYJOB2 AS (SELECT JOB_NAME, JOB_STATUS, SUBSYSTEM, AUTHORIZATION_NAME FROM TABLE(QSYS2.ACTIVE_JOB_INFO(JOB_NAME_FILTER => ''C0906A'')) X WHERE AUTHORIZATION_NAME = CURRENT_USER) WITH DATA') COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: ENTS

steps.label: CLEAN
steps.cmd:
DLTDTAQ DTAQ(&LIB/Z0906A)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
DLTDTAQ DTAQ(&LIB/Z0906B)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
DLTMSGQ MSGQ(&LIB/Z0906C)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
DLTPGM PGM(&LIB/C0906A)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
RUNSQL SQL('DROP TABLE &LIB/W0906A') COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.sql: SELECT TAG, ORD, LIB, TYPE FROM &LIB.VFYCUR ORDER BY TAG, ORD
SELECT SEQ, TS, PHASE, MSG FROM &LIB.VFYWLOG ORDER BY SEQ
SELECT COLUMN_NAME, DATA_TYPE, LENGTH, CCSID FROM QSYS2.SYSCOLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = '&LIB' AND TABLE_NAME = 'VFYRC1' ORDER BY ORDINAL_POSITION
SELECT OBJNAME, OBJTYPE FROM TABLE(QSYS2.OBJECT_STATISTICS('&LIB', '*ALL')) X WHERE OBJNAME LIKE 'Z0906%' OR OBJNAME LIKE 'C0906%' OR OBJNAME LIKE 'W0906%' ORDER BY OBJNAME
SELECT JOB_NAME, JOB_STATUS FROM TABLE(QSYS2.ACTIVE_JOB_INFO(JOB_NAME_FILTER => 'C0906A')) X WHERE AUTHORIZATION_NAME = CURRENT_USER

SELECT SPECIFIC_NAME, ORDINAL_POSITION, PARAMETER_MODE, PARAMETER_NAME, DATA_TYPE, CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH FROM QSYS2.SYSPARMS WHERE SPECIFIC_SCHEMA = 'QSYS2' AND SPECIFIC_NAME IN ('SEND_DATA_QUEUE', 'RECEIVE_DATA_QUEUE', 'DATA_QUEUE_ENTRIES', 'MESSAGE_QUEUE_INFO') ORDER BY SPECIFIC_NAME, ORDINAL_POSITION
SELECT * FROM QSYS2.SYSPARMS WHERE SPECIFIC_SCHEMA = 'QSYS2' AND SPECIFIC_NAME = 'RECEIVE_DATA_QUEUE' ORDER BY ORDINAL_POSITION
